title: Random-walk displacement on circle-packed doubling graphs
exact_target: Does random walk on a planar graph with uniformly more than quadratic polynomial growth move subdiffusively, with exponent at most the reciprocal of the growth dimension?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000031 (AMR-099-0031). CC BY 4.0.

Itai Benjamini, \emph{Coarse Geometry and Randomness}, Saint-Flour lecture notes, version dated 30 October 2013; original author manuscript preserved in Arquivo.pt capture of 31 December 2020, Section 7, Definition 7.8 and Conjecture 7.9, p. 55.
